classification: Read-only qualification of the immutable filled candidate's 61 new local segments, five separately contracted exterior replacements, and ten ordinary vias. No copper, fill, placement, manifest, CAD, active package, or historical report was changed.

segment_region_and_layer_gate.method: Exact parametric interval coverage of each complete segment centreline by the union of the original local box x86.6..93.1,y90.5..95.9, upper corridor x86.6..93.1,y89.2..90.5, and only for /IMU_INT2 on In2 the extension x93.1..94.2,y92.1..92.95.
segment_region_and_layer_gate.interface_endcaps: Centreline endpoints on declared boundaries are accepted; this does not authorize arbitrary centreline extension outside the released regions.

ordinary_via_gate.annulus_interpretation: 0.127 mm is the nominal result of the prescribed dimensions. It is not the project minimum and is not a manufacturing-tolerance qualification.

methods.off_pad: Native F/B SMD effective polygons intersected with a 0.302 mm annulus polygon generated using 1 IU ERROR_OUTSIDE; positive area is forbidden including same-net lands.
methods.foreign_copper: Native primitive shapes and actual filled-island polygons, preserving island holes, tested at 0.20 mm minus 1 IU.
methods.circular_drills: Exact integer centre-distance clearance using actual drill radii.
methods.pad_and_USB_slot_drills: Saved PAD GetEffectiveHoleShape().Collide(candidate hole circle, 0.25 mm minus 1 IU); no round-slot substitution.
methods.contacts: Authoritative mirrored base-tab and under-cell polygons tested against the exposed B/full-span annulus at 0.302+0.25=0.552 mm centre exclusion.

added_segment_clearance_gate.layer_policy: Only B.Cu segments were treated as exposed contact-side copper. F.Cu traces beneath B contacts were not incorrectly rejected as B copper.
added_segment_clearance_gate.minimum_margin_limit: The exercised native collision API establishes the required pass thresholds but does not expose a repository-qualified exact polygon-to-polygon distance result; no optimistic additional margin was inferred.

reused_completed_gates.private_pickoffs: Both measured independent until their declared terminals.
